title: Generation Core Module
summary: This module provides core functionalities for text generation in models, including various decoding strategies like greedy, sampling, beam search, and assisted decoding, along with continuous batching capabilities.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Generation Process
nodes.title: GenerationMixin.generate()
nodes.description: The main entry point for text generation, coordinating configuration, input preparation, decoding strategies, and output handling.

nodes.label: Provide Continuous Batching API
nodes.title: ContinuousMixin
nodes.description: Exposes methods for initializing and managing continuous batching inference, allowing efficient processing of multiple generation requests.

nodes.label: Generate Sequences in Batches
nodes.title: ContinuousMixin.generate_batch()
nodes.description: Generates sequences for a batch of prompts using continuous batching, optimizing throughput for multiple requests.

nodes.label: Initialize Batching Manager
nodes.title: init_continuous_batching()
nodes.description: Sets up the ContinuousBatchingManager, configuring it with generation and batching parameters.

nodes.label: Manage Continuous Batching Requests
nodes.title: ContinuousBatchingManager
nodes.description: Handles the lifecycle of continuous batching requests, from adding new prompts to retrieving generated results.

nodes.label: Configure Generation Parameters
nodes.title: _prepare_generation_config()
nodes.description: Prepares and updates the GenerationConfig object, merging default values, model-specific settings, and user-provided arguments.

nodes.label: Prepare Model Inputs for Forward Pass
nodes.title: prepare_inputs_for_generation()
nodes.description: Transforms raw inputs and model state into the format expected by the model's forward pass, including handling past key-value states and attention masks.

nodes.label: Apply Logits Processors
nodes.title: _get_logits_processor()
nodes.description: Constructs a list of LogitsProcessor instances to modify prediction scores based on generation configuration (e.g., repetition penalty, temperature).

nodes.label: Define Generation Stopping Criteria
nodes.title: _get_stopping_criteria()
nodes.description: Assembles a list of StoppingCriteria instances to determine when to halt the generation process (e.g., max length, EOS token).

nodes.label: Manage Key-Value Pair Cache
nodes.title: _prepare_cache_for_generation()
nodes.description: Initializes or updates the key-value pair cache (e.g., DynamicCache, StaticCache) to optimize subsequent generation steps.

nodes.label: Process Special Tokens
nodes.title: _prepare_special_tokens()
nodes.description: Converts special token IDs (BOS, EOS, PAD) into tensor format and performs validation for generation.

nodes.label: Validate Generation Parameters
nodes.title: Validation Methods
nodes.description: Ensures that generation parameters, model keyword arguments, and length constraints are valid and consistent before starting generation.

nodes.label: Optimize Model for Decoding
nodes.title: _optimize_model_for_decode()
nodes.description: Applies optimizations like switching expert implementations or checking auto-compilation criteria for improved decoding performance.

nodes.label: Perform Greedy or Sample Decoding
nodes.title: _sample()
nodes.description: Executes multinomial sampling or greedy decoding to generate the next token based on processed logits.

nodes.label: Perform Beam Search Decoding
nodes.title: _beam_search()
nodes.description: Implements beam search to explore multiple token sequences simultaneously, selecting the most probable paths.

nodes.label: Perform Assisted Decoding
nodes.title: _assisted_decoding()
nodes.description: Utilizes an assistant model to propose candidate tokens, accelerating the generation process by reducing main model calls.

nodes.label: Execute Custom Generation Logic
nodes.title: load_custom_generate()
nodes.description: Allows loading and executing user-defined generation functions from external repositories or callables.

nodes.label: Prefill Initial Sequence
nodes.title: _prefill()
nodes.description: Processes the initial input sequence to populate the key-value cache before the iterative decoding loop begins.

nodes.label: Update Model State for Next Step
nodes.title: _update_model_kwargs_for_generation()
nodes.description: Adjusts model keyword arguments (e.g., attention mask, position IDs, past key-values) after each token generation.

nodes.label: Assistant Model
nodes.title: PreTrainedModel
nodes.description: An auxiliary model used to accelerate generation in assisted decoding strategies.

nodes.label: Tokenizer
nodes.title: PreTrainedTokenizerBase
nodes.description: Used for tokenizing inputs, decoding outputs, and handling special tokens during generation.

nodes.label: Generation Configuration Object
nodes.title: GenerationConfig
nodes.description: A data class holding all parameters that control the generation process, such as max_length, num_beams, and sampling strategies.

nodes.label: Logits Processor List
nodes.title: LogitsProcessorList
nodes.description: A collection of functions that modify the raw output logits before token selection, implementing various constraints or sampling techniques.

nodes.label: Stopping Criteria List
nodes.title: StoppingCriteriaList
nodes.description: A collection of criteria that determine when the generation process should terminate, such as reaching a maximum length or encountering an EOS token.

nodes.label: Key-Value Pair Cache Object
nodes.title: Cache
nodes.description: Stores intermediate key and value states from previous attention layers to avoid recomputing them in subsequent generation steps.
